test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence and complete the sentence correctly.

It is important to take this opportunity to make a name for yourself – __beat around the bush__.

options.text: strike while the iron is hot

solution:
he correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the idiom 'beat around the bush' is incorrect.
 
• The correct idiom **'strike while the iron is hot'** means to **take advantage of an opportunity as soon as it presents itself.**
 
• The sentence should e**ncourage taking immediate action rather than delaying or avoiding the main point.**
 
• Therefore, the correct idiom to use is **'strike while the iron is hot'.**

Hence, the correct sentence is **"*It is important to take this opportunity to make a name for yourself – strike while the iron is hot."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The idiom **'strike while the iron is hot'** originates from blacksmithing, where it is important to shape the **metal while it is still hot and malleable.**
 
• Using** idioms correctly can greatly enhance the expressiveness and clarity of your language.**
